programme.title: Newscast
programme.desc: Join BBC journalists including political editor Laura Kuenssberg, Europe editor Katya Adler, Brussels correspondent Adam Fleming and political correspondent Chris Mason in their weekly podcast discussing all of the news stories that matter to the people of the United Kingdom. The journalists know all about the stories that they're talking about - they interview the most important people involved in the stories that feature in the news. They speak of their knowledge and understanding of the news in a way that is understandable for all. Laura is often in a car in the middle of a city where big politics stories are happening. Katya, Adam and Chris are usually in the studio. They regularly talk about Brexit and what is going to happen when the United Kingdom leaves the European Union.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: The latest news from the BBC,which is designed to inform you on current affairs. The BBC is aims to be a totally impartial public service broadcaster, and was established by Royal Charter. The BBC is funded by a licence fee paid by British households, and is regulated by Ofcom. They aim to create high-quality content, in order to inform and educate, but also entertain, their audience Millions of people from all over the world watch content produced by the BBC, and they are well respected as a media company. It was founded in 1922, with its headquarters in Westminster, London.

programme.title: Newsday
programme.desc: "Good Morning Asia, hello World." Join the news teams from BBC World News in London and Singapore. This live news and current affairs program is broadcast globally and focuses on all the latest news and breaking developing stories that matter around the world. The show is usually presented by Rico Hizon in Singapore and Kasia Madera in London. Broadcasting live at midnight GMT on both BBC World News and the BBC News channel, the show is broadcast in the morning in Asia and therefore is marketed as a morning show for people watching around the country. The show is often followed by Asia Business Report live from Singapore which reports on all the latest economy and business figures from the country.

programme.desc: Focus on Africa is a BBC news program broadcast globally and on local partner channels of the BBC in African countries. The program used to be presented by Komla Dumor each weekday from its inception until his death in 2014; now it is hosted by Sophie Ikenye, a news presenter from Kenya. The program includes news, sport and business from across Africa and the rest of the globe. Get the top African stories and keep up with the latest international events.

programme.title: BBC World News America
programme.desc: News presenter Katty Kay keeps you up to date with all the latest breaking news from America and the rest of the world on BBC World News America. This world renowned news and current affairs program has been recognised for its exceptional reporting at the Emmy Awards. BBC World News America won two Emmy awards for its coverage of the conflicts in Syria and the Central African Republic. You can catch up with this award winning broadcast team as they air multiple times a day throughout the week.

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: In-depth news and current affairs review of the main political and economic stories of the day, featuring robust interviews with senior government and opposition figures, business and union leaders, and analytical reports that delve behind the headlines. Regular presenters cross-examine studio guests on details of policies, priorities, actions and inactions, on a range of domestic UK and international topics. There are weekly features on the arts, sports and the world of technology, and editors are not afraid to venture into niche, specialist and exotic areas from space travel to animal psychology. If the BBC's flagship Radio 4 Today programme sets the early morning news agenda for the day, then its late-night TV equivalent often gives the people in power some sleepless nights.

programme.title: Harvey Beaks
programme.desc: Harvey Beaks is a good kid on a mission to have fun, and nothing can stand in his way! Well, except for the fact that he irons his bed sheets and is always on time. Will his best friends, Fee and Foo, be able to help Harvey tap into his wild side? From fighting a gang of squirrels to stealing bikes from Randl the grumpy raccoon, there are tons of adventures to be had in Bigbark Woods. programme.title: Wallykazam!

programme.title: Winx Club
programme.desc: Meet Bloom, a girl from Earth, who after she finds out that she is a fairy joins Alfea College on the planet Magix- a magical universe that is inhabited by fairies, witches and other mythical creatures. programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: In New Jersey, the Good Grief community focuses on a holistic way of dealing with grief, where children can give in to rage in 'the volcano room,' and say goodbye to a dying teddy bear patient in 'the hospital room.' Over the course of a year, we follow the weekly meetings and get close to Kimmy, Nicky, Peter, Nora, Nolan, and Mikayla and their close companion: grief. It is sometimes heartbreaking, but also humorous, to experience the questions about life and death through their open and curious minds. Grief is high and heavy as a mountain, but it helps you understand what has happened, and that death is irreversible.

programme.desc: "The Zoo: San Diego" provides a behind the scenes look at the daily lives of various species of animals and the teams that care for them. A wide range of animals are introduced, including pandas, giraffes, Galapagos tortoises, koalas, elephants, mountain lions, two baby cheetahs that are learning how to be ambassadors for their species and a flock of ostriches known as the "Spice Girls." Besides the animals, the keepers and veterinarians at both the Zoo and the Safari Park -- many of whom have dedicated their lives to caring for animals, discuss what it's like to be a part of this world-renowned zoo.

programme.title: The Aquarium
programme.desc: Reality-documentary series following the lives of the aquatic inhabitants at the Georgia Aquarium. The largest in the United States and fourth-largest in the world, the aquarium boasts a wide range of diverse inhabitants and explores the relationship between animals and trainers. The 10-million-gallon (38-million-litre) facility plays home to over 500 marine species including endangered penguins, rescued sea otters and recovering sea lions. The show reveals the difficulties that come with nursing and caring for such a wide variety of species. With many heart-warming scenes, the series beautifully reveals the friendships between the different species and how they learn to co-exist with each other.

programme.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
programme.desc: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet is a TV series entirely dedicated to love and care for animals. Thanks to a genius Dr. Jeff Young Denver's Planned Pethood Plus veterinary clinic is always busy and is taking care of 80,000-plus clients and their pets. Dr. Jeff's sharp surgical skills and his unconditional love for animals make him one of the most respected vets in the country. Dr. Jeff has a dedicated team of more than 30 veterinary staffers and once a month they go to remote locations where people do not have access to vets.

programme.title: Tanked
programme.desc: Follow aquarium enthusiasts Brett Raymer and Wayde King as they attempt to build some of the most luxurious fish tanks in the world. At Acrylic Tank Manufacturing, the brothers-in-law guide you through the design process and the building of their truly jaw-dropping aquariums. Experience the unveiling of finished tanks housed everywhere from restaurants and banks, to glamorous casinos and mansions. Join the duo in their Las Vegas workshop as they deliver some budget-shattering builds to their high-profile clientele.

programme.title: Animal Cops: Philadelphia
programme.desc: Animal Cops: Philadelphia follows the work of the Pennsylvania SPCA's Humane Law Enforcement team as they investigate cases of animal cruelty; rescue sick and abused animals and fight for justice on their behalf. The Pennsylvania SPCA's humane law enforcement officers cover an area of over 46,000 square miles from their headquarters in Philadelphia. The six offic ers with full police powers and six agent trainees are on call 24 hours a day seven days a week protecting the city's one and a half million pets.

programme.title: The Vet Life
programme.desc: The Vet Life is an amazing series revolving around three friends, three vets, Diarra Blue, Aubrey Ross, and Mike Lavigne and their everyday lives. These guys became friends back in University, then they worked in Las Vegas and finally moved to Texas and opened a full-service veterinary hospital of their own. The series highlights their daily routine, their duties at work and at home, their families and pets.

programme.title: Treehouse Masters
programme.desc: Treehouse Masters is an American reality television series hosted by Pete Nelson, a treehouse builder. Pete and his team design and build all types of treehouses for clients across the country. The clients and Pete's team are the people who never stop dreaming. You'll be surprised to know how many people want to get away from the noisy comfortable cities and live in close communion with mother nature. So getting a treehouse is their chance to live a dream. Every episode will amaze you because of Pete's talent and incredible imagination. He can build any type of a treehouse, starting from a small simple ones to most complex residences with all modern communication. Every wish of a customer will be heard and fulfilled.

programme.title: Pit Bulls & Parolees
programme.desc: Pit bulls are eager to please, faithful and enthusiastic friends and pleasant with children according to credible canine organizations. But they have fallen from grace. Now often associated with gang members, dog fighting and attacks. That's about to change. Animal Planet introduces you to this dog's greatest ally, and she's not a man - she's a fiery red-headed leading lady, and she's determined to end the needless hostility toward pit bulls. Meet Tia Maria Torres - 49-year-old mother, top pit bull trainer and founder and owner of Villalobos Rescue Center - the country's largest rescue facility for pit bulls.

programme.title: My Cat from Hell
programme.desc: Jackson Galaxy is a cat behaviorist. He is the person who resolves conflicts or behavioral issues between the owners and their cats or even between the cats and other pets. These are attacks and misbehavior, and Jackson is a true cat-lover and a believer that any problem can be solved thanks to love, patience and proper handling. Taking good care of cats is a demanding process and a whole science, but in return you will get a loving and purring family member.

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
programme.desc: US reality TV show follows the Irwin family through their adventures in continuing Steve Irwin's legacy. The family share their wildlife experiences from their travels across the world. They show how they care for all the animals while giving insight into their family life at Australia Zoo where they live and work. The Australian family including mother Terri who is a naturalist and conservationist stars alongside daughter Bindi and son Robert who are fully immerse in animal life and their family.

Thanks to their unbelievable imagination, creativity and professionalism they can turn every pool into an ultimate backyard oasis for a whole family and transform it into a natural lagoon. They prefer working with hand-selected stones from Tennessee.

programme.desc: Nature's great predators are animals you don't want to come across, especially when you find yourself in their own backyard. In this heart-pumping documentary series, individuals share their stories of encounters with dangerous animals, reliving the frightful, life-threatening ordeal. With stories from across the world, we reveal the heart-in-mouth moments when these lucky individuals managed to escape the jaws of death. From a swimmer mauled by a bull shark in the Bahamas to a close shave with a grizzly bear in the mountains, these stories showcase the fearsome power of predators.

programme.title: Bad Dog
programme.desc: BAD DOG! is a hilarious hour of television documenting just how far pets can push their owners and still get unconditional love. The series highlights dogs that double as destroyers, hissing cats, cussing parrots, and the most fascinating four-legged escape artists ever caught on tape. Viewers will be treated to candid animal antics you truly have to see to believe. They are some of the baddest pets on the planet and you'll meet their owners who love them just the way they are. We span the globe to crown the Baddest of the Bad on BAD DOG!.

programme.title: Jeremy Wade's Dark Waters
programme.desc: Join biologist and angling expert Jeremy Wade as he travels the world peering through our darkest, murky waters, investigating tales of mythical monsters, mutated beasts and depleting fish populations. The star of River Monsters is back to explain the unexplainable, as he investigates these reported sightings of unknown creatures. Whether it's Lake Garda's reptilian monster, a species of pike the size of a man, a river monster deemed extinct in the Outback or South Africa's fabled half-man, half-fish monster, Jeremy will need to use all of his experience if he is to catch, or even glimpse, these creatures.

programme.desc: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives is American food reality television series about places with the most delicious food. Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

Each episode sees one of the chefs being eliminated from the show until there is only one left, the winner who is awarded the title of 'Master of Cue'. This show is an absolute treat.

The Pioneer Woman is an open invitation into Ree Drummond's life: The award-winning blogger and best-selling cookbook author comes to Food Network and shares her special brand of home cooking, from throw-together suppers to elegant celebrations. The series, set against the incredible story of life at home on the range, is the next best thing to actually sitting on a stool in Ree's kitchen.

programme.desc: This paranormal reality series follows explorer and ghost hunter Dakota Laden who partners up his sister Chelsea and best friend Tanner, to travel across the country in an RV and visit the most haunted locations in America -dark corridors of Brushy Mountain State Penitentiary, notorious Eloise Psychiatric Hospital, terrifying St. Albans Sanatorium and many more, as they learn the blood-chilling stories behind this scary places and face their darkest fears.

programme.title: Ghost Loop
programme.desc: Follow a team of highly specialized paranormal experts, who help both the living and the dead and focus on a distinct type of haunting - ''ghost loop'', which happens when paranormal entities terrorize the living through endless and repetitive supernatural cycles, manifesting again and again in the same location. In each episode, paranormal investigator and medium Sean Austin, empath Kris Star, researcher and tech advisor Chris Califf, design specialist Eric Vitale, and tech support Matt Lytle, examine and research their client's property and history. Then, they formulate a plan they believe will help stop the haunting - whether it's building a 1900s-era train compartment, replicating a tavern from the 1850s, or constructing a 19th century baby's nursery. The team uses emotionally charged settings to draw out the entities in hopes that it will release the energy and break the loop once and for all.

programme.title: Ghost Nation
programme.desc: Hair-rising American reality series that follows paranormal investigators Jason Hawes, Steve Gonsalves and Dave Tango, known from the ''Ghost Hunters'' television series, as they respond to calls from people who need their help with the cases of reportedly haunted locations around the United States. The guys are members of the paranormal investigation group- T.A.P.S., which Hawes founded, and they helped to create ''United Paranormal Research Organization (UPRO)'', which aims to be a global paranormal investigation organization that keeps local organizations connected. programme.title: Mysteries At The Museum
programme.desc: Documentary series in which host Don Wildman, history enthusiast and adventurer, focuses on interesting and unusual artifacts held in museums, historical institutions, and unexplored archives around the world. Don discovers extraordinary, obscure relics and artifacts, shares their incredible stories, that have either been forgotten or are lesser known, and reveals their secrets, taking the viewers on a spectacular tour through history. We also get to find out why and how some of these unusual objects ended up in the museums.

programme.title: Edge of Alaska
programme.desc: Hidden deep in the wilderness of eastern Alaska and built during the Gold Rush as Alaska's original 'Sin City', only 42 residents currently brave the extreme conditions in McCarthy. It's an isolated outlaw town - a refuge for people who don't want to be found that's surrounded by extreme wilderness over 100 miles from the authorities where young men go to prove themselves and old outlaws go to die; hunters, gold miners, gunsmiths, and survivalists who reside in this 'Old West' town are willing to risk their lives to live truly free. While some believe in continuing the town's frontier way of life, others feel the future of McCarthy depends on dragging itself into the modern age. Which way of life will reign supreme?

programme.title: Finding Bigfoot
programme.desc: From small towns in the South to remote areas of the Pacific Northwest and Alaska, four eccentric but passionate members of the Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization (BFRO) embark on one single-minded mission: to find the elusive "creature" known as Bigfoot or the Sasquatch. The team consists of Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization (BFRO) founder and President Matt Moneymaker, researchers James "Bobo" Fay and Cliff Barackman and skeptical scientist Ranae Holland. The series never questions the existence of Bigfoot, but rather documents the team's search efforts and study of evidence in an attempt to prove the existence of the elusive creature.

programme.title: Mountain Monsters
programme.desc: Mountain Monsters is an American cryptozoology-themed reality TV series revolving around the Appalachian Investigators of Mysterious Sightings team. It is a group of six skilled native West Virginian hunters and trappers. They are on a mission to study and track unidentified creatures in the Appalachian Mountains. Their main goal is to prove that mysterious creatures like Bigfoot, Werewolf, Hellhound, Lizard Man, and Mothman do exist and provide the proper evidence to the viewers.

programme.title: Haunted Towns
programme.desc: The TWC team (Tennessee Wraith Chasers) travel across the US to investigate stories of hauntings and horrors, attempting to establish whether there are supernatural forces at play or if they're just folklore. The team is made up of Chris Smith, Steven McDougal, Scott Porter and Brannon Smith. Together they interview witnesses and gather evidence, uncovering the fact behind the fiction to decipher what or who is causing the hauntings. These paranormal places are scattered across America and have long claimed to have spooky pasts; the team hope they can solve the mysteries once and for all. Reality series.

programme.title: The Dead Files
programme.desc: On "The Dead Files," Cindy Kaza, an evidential medium, and Steve DiSchiavi, a retired NYPD homicide detective, join forces to investigate paranormal activity in haunted locations across the United States. Their unique talents combine to create a powerful team that aims to unravel the mysteries of the supernatural world. With a blend of psychic intuition and investigative skills, Kaza and DiSchiavi explored the boundaries between the living and the dead, seeking answers to unexplained phenomena that defy conventional explanations. Their captivating narratives offer viewers a glimpse into the uncharted territories of the afterlife, bridging the gap between this world and the next.

programme.title: The Alaska Triangle
programme.desc: Experts and eyewitnesses attempt to unlock the mystery of the Alaska Triangle, a remote area infamous for alien abductions, Bigfoot sightings, paranormal phenomena and vanishing airplanes. Throughout the series, we meet a woman whose idyllic Alaskan dream soon descends into a paranormal nightmare, as she starts to suffer attacks by an unseen force. Recent sightings may prove that a Native American legend about a mysterious race of giants is true. The series also explores The Missing Douglas and whether an interdimensional portal in the Alaska Triangle led to the disappearance of the airplane carrying 44 military personnel in 1950.

programme.title: Destination Fear
programme.desc: This paranormal reality series follows explorer and ghost hunter Dakota Laden who partners up his sister Chelsea and best friend Tanner, to travel across the country in an RV and visit the most haunted locations in America -dark corridors of Brushy Mountain State Penitentiary, notorious Eloise Psychiatric Hospital, terrifying St. Albans Sanatorium and many more, as they learn the blood-chilling stories behind this scary places and face their darkest fears.

programme.title: The Lake Erie Murders
programme.desc: Coming from the beautiful environs of Lake Erie, straddling the border between the US and Canada, this true life crime show focuses on the more sinister and gruesome tales of some of the region's darkest and deadliest crimes. We explore baffling and mysterious murder cases such as that of the 1989 kidnapping and murder of 10-year-old Amy Mihaljevic which provoked much speculation and intrigue in the area and which is still an open case. Each hourlong episode delves into the case history, analyzes the facts and evidence and carefully examines the detection procedures and how each suspect was cleared of suspicion. Subsequent episodes detail four additional deadly crimes that were solved by local law enforcement.

programme.title: The Real Story with Maria Elena Salinas
programme.desc: Investigative journalist Maria Elena Salinas uses her years of experience to unearth new evidence in criminal cases that have made national headlines. Dubbed the "Voice of Hispanic America" by The New York Times, Maria has travelled the world, reporting on war crimes and interviewing heads of state, dictators, US Presidents and many notable politicians. This series sees Maria seeking truths about crimes committed on US soil, finding the evidence to overturn wrongful convictions, uncovering the clues to prosecute murderers and helping families find closure.

programme.title: Death In the Bayou: The Jennings 8
programme.desc: Between 2005 and 2009, 8 women were murdered in the small town of Jennings, Louisiana. Although they all knew each other and their bodies were discovered in very similar circumstances, local police refuse to link the deaths. While some residents think the murders could be the work of a serial killer, others believe a darker conspiracy is at work and it may even include members of law enforcement. As they wait in vain for the investigation to move forward, the victim's families refuse to give up in their quest for justice. But with the investigation into all 8 deaths still open, police aren't talking, leaving the community haunted by the question: who killed the Jennings 8?

programme.title: Still A Mystery
programme.desc: Just because a case is closed doesn't mean the truth has been revealed. Suicide or murder? Runaway or kidnapping? Accidental or premeditated? Each episode of STILL A MYSTERY re-examines a single crime case where unanswered questions still remain. Through original interviews with law enforcement, family members and private investigators, news footage and social media, STILL A MYSTERY dissects the evidence and presents new theories in a quest to uncover the truth.

programme.title: Evil Lives Here: Shadows Of Death
programme.desc: Evil casts a shadow. That shadow spreads outward for years, even decades, after a crime. It consumes everyone in its path, pulling them into darkness. Can they find the light? Evil Lives Here: Shadows of Death explores the endless reach of evil, a reach that extends long after the act of evil itself. This original series highlights the struggle to survive as innocent people find themselves caught in the wake of death and evil.

programme.title: American Chopper
programme.desc: American Chopper is an American reality television series that revolves around the Teutuls- Paul Senior, his sons Paul Junior and Michael who work together at Orange County Choppers, a custom motorcycle fabrication company located in Montgomery, New York. The series is a mix of competition and drama, famous for real fighting, cursing, crying, welding, and painting. It's indisputable that each Teutul is a gifted mechanic, engineer and designer, they put together a motorbike in front of the viewers and make every customer's wish come true.

programme.title: Gold Rush: Freddy Dodge's Mine Rescue
programme.desc: A gold mining veteran with more than 40 years of mining under his belt, Freddy Dodge has earned the name "Gold Guru." After proving himself to be an invaluable gold recovery expert on GOLD RUSH, Freddy is taking his tool belt on the road to stop struggling mine owners from striking out.

programme.title: Street Outlaws
programme.desc: Reality series focuses on the amazing opportunity to dive into American street racing world. Look at how need for speed unites people and find out what adrenaline addicts are ready for in Oklahoma, unofficial capital of illegal street racing. Only top racers participate in the competition, they want to appear and stay at the A-list, everything they have to do is to try to squeeze as much performance out of their vehicles as possible.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters
programme.desc: Drew Pritchard is a modern-day treasure hunter searching the back roads of the UK to discover hidden riches. With demanding customers, high turnover and one of the biggest decorative salvage yards in the UK, Drew is constantly on the road, crisscrossing the country in search of derelict gems and forgotten remnants. Drew loves the thrill of the hunt and while he gets his hands dirty in the country's architectural backwaters, his crack team of restorers is back at the shop giving old and rare finds a new lease on life. Follow Drew and his crack team of specialists on a fascinating journey through the entire picking process – from the initial expedition, to renewal, and finally to resale. Showcasing his hard-earned knowledge and appreciation of salvage and restoration, each episode accompanies Drew on one big buying venture, such as setting off with an empty van and returning with a 20th century stained glass Gothic doorway from an Irish monastery – as well as the small, unpredictable adventures along the way. Simply discovering a treasure is only half the battle, as Drew must artfully convince owners to sell, and at his price. After a successful purchase, Drew and his team of experts bring the items back to Fabulously British Salvage, his tremendous 20,000 square foot showroom located in North Wales, to restore them to their original brilliance, before reselling them for profit. This is not an easy business, as any trip can feature the next great find or a bust that costs Drew and his team thousands. However, Drew's keen eye and adroit negotiating skills are second to none – his passion and drive for success make him one of the best in the business.

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers
programme.desc: Buy, repair and restore and then resell a classic car in order to make profit- this is what Wheeler Dealers is about. The budget is limited, though you can see some exclusive and rare cars. Mike Brewer, a British dealer chooses the car carefully and hands it over to the mechanic, first Edd China, later Ant Anstead to be fixed and upgraded. The hosts are real masters of their trade, it seems they can bring life even to a piece of metal. It does not matter if you are a life-long car enthusiast or do not even have a driving license you will admire the results of hard work from the beginning to the end of the long uneasy restoring process.

programme.desc: Have you ever wondered how things that surround us every day are produced? Find out about the whole process from the beginning to the end in a documentary television series How It's Made. The series demonstrates how various items like clothing and accessories, food, industrial products, cars, musical instruments and many more are manufactured. Who would have thought how exciting it would be to watch a cupcake, formula 1 race car or gummy vitamins being made?

programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: As the modern world becomes progressively automated and mechanised it's easy to become detached from how things are made and how they work. The hit series returns to uncover the miraculous feats of engineering which underpin life in the 21st century. How the seemingly mundane are often the result of highly sophisticated engineering and production processes. This fascinating behind-the-scenes journey delves deep into the production of everyday modern items from surfboards to satchels and trombones to cricket bats.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters: The Restorers
programme.desc: Expert craftsmen are bringing Drew Pritchard's finds back to life and restore them to their former glory. Drew hunts for treasures such as derelict gems and forgotten remnants across the country. And then he and his team do the restoration turning trash to gold, so that worn objects become shining gems for which Drew's customers want to pay a lot of money. All kinds of items can and will be restored, starting from a century-old suitcase to an ancient coffee machine, from a ravaged carousel horse to a large railway clock.

programme.title: The Great Antiques Challenge
programme.desc: Six antiques dealers go head-to-head to find the perfect antique, collectable or curio for a client, using their own money to buy items that will solve a particular problem at a price they are willing to pay.

programme.title: Tiny House Hunters
programme.desc: Reality series showing American house hunters who are considering joining the tiny-house revolution where people are choosing to live in smaller homes - often less than 55 square metres -and praising their benefits. In this property series realtors present three petite houses to prospective buyers. Some of the homes would be used as permanent residences whilst others could be a retreat to escape to. There are various reasons for the trend for tiny-living; some people are doing it for financial reasons, others are trying to live more ecologically and some yearn for a simpler lifestyle. When the potential tiny-homeowners are faced with the practical limitations of the properties on offer will they take the plunge and embrace the joys of tiny living? Or will they change their minds for more spacious accommodation?

programme.title: Overhaulin'
programme.desc: Overhaulin' is an American reality TV series about customizing cars. The main difference from the other shows of this type is detailed presentation of the technical process and import scene plus serious-minded approach to the car owner's needs. The hosts are Chip Foose and Chris Jacobs. The concept of the series is that the car owner is absolutely unaware of what's going on. His car disappears one day and the owner is convinced that it has been stolen, misplaced or lost at a mechanic's shop, or has been towed away by police. Chip Foose and a team of mechanics have a week to remake the car into a custom masterpiece. Each show ends up with the surprise reuniting of the owner and his customized baby on four wheels.

programme.title: Homestead Rescue
programme.desc: This reality TV show follows Marty Raney and his two children, Matt Raney and Misty Bilodeau, who are successful homesteaders from the state of Alaska and have the skills needed to fish, hunt, raise livestock, and otherwise survive in an untamed landscape. Struggling homesteaders across the country call these experts to help them save their homesteads and become self-sufficient while they teach them the necessary skills to survive the wilderness.

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers World Tour
programme.desc: Mike and Elvis travel to Turin and set about trying to rescue a rundown Fiat Barchetta. Unfortunately, parts prove almost impossible to find.

programme.title: Kindig Customs
programme.desc: Bitchin' Rides is a reality styled TV show hosted by Dave Kindig from the Salt Lake City, Utah-based company Kindig It Designs. Dave's real passion is designing and building custom cars. We watch the process of restoring and rebuilding all types and all periods of cars. In each episode Dave and his team review a car, create a design, then the team takes it apart and rebuilds to create a one-of-a-kind gem. Things get really ugly before they get pretty. Dave has the best team of top mechanics, technicians and fabricators in the business, quality is their only focus when they create the baddest bitchin' rides.

programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: How Do They Do It? Ever wondered how the stripes get into toothpaste or how contact lenses are made? How do goods get from one country to another and then into our supermarkets? What are car tires made from and exactly why are plasma TV screens flat? Eating, drinking, driving, flying. These all are activities that we carry out with barely a second thought. But have you ever wondered what exactly goes into your teabag and how it got there? How does an airport handle hundreds of thousands of items of luggage each day? And just how can a car's airbag inflate so quickly? Every day – often without even realizing it – we come into contact with technology, be it in the bathroom, in the car or on the golf course. We take a look at how things work, and focus on some of the most amazing examples of everyday objects including the world's fastest elevator and the most expensive chocolate money can buy.

programme.title: Alaska: The Last Frontier
programme.desc: American reality series is about Alaskan pioneers Yule and Ruth Kilcher and their kids living together at their homestead. The Kilchers demonstrate one-of-a-kind model of surviving in severe conditions of the last frontier. Enjoy amazing panorama views of Alaska, showing its various nature. Sitting in a comfortable chair in your warm apartment just try to imagine how it really is when electricity and running water is not inevitable fact of life. The Kilchers hunt, go fishing, garden, gather, raise livestock in order to survive Alaska's uncontrollable power and wilderness.

programme.title: Kindig Customs: Road To The Ridler
programme.desc: The pinnacle of the custom car world is the Don Ridler Award, given out every year at the Detroit Autorama. Dave Kindig has always had a Ridler-sized itch he needed to scratch, and has finally found the right client and idea to make it a reality.

programme.title: Mike Brewer: Born Dealer
programme.desc: Mike buys a stinker of a car at auction. Plus, a BMW M3 turns into a rotten headache and Mike tries to sell The Stig a nice little runaround.

programme.title: Body Cam
programme.desc: Documentary series following police officers across the USA as they put their lives on the line to enforce the law. Using real footage from the officer's body cameras, we show just how deadly routine checks can be, with law enforcement officials having to think on their feet and make split-second decisions to potentially save their, or someone else's, life. From knife-wielding maniacs to brutal shootouts, the series highlights the importance of our police departments. With interviews from the officers involved adding context to the footage, Body Cam Cops gives viewers unprecedented, exclusive access to what life is truly like in the line of duty.

programme.title: American Chopper
programme.desc: American Chopper is an American reality television series that revolves around the Teutuls- Paul Senior, his sons Paul Junior and Michael who work together at Orange County Choppers, a custom motorcycle fabrication company located in Montgomery, New York. The series is a mix of competition and drama, famous for real fighting, cursing, crying, welding, and painting. It's indisputable that each Teutul is a gifted mechanic, engineer and designer, they put together a motorbike in front of the viewers and make every customer's wish come true.

programme.title: The Bad Skin Clinic
programme.desc: British docuseries following the work of leading dermatologist, Dr Emma Craythorne as she explores extreme skin conditions. Join her team at their Harley Street clinic in London, as she meets patients who have been seriously affected by a range of often debilitating conditions. From severe acne and rosacea to deep painful cysts, follow the stories of the patients from diagnosis through to recovery as they undergo dramatic cosmetic procedures. For the patients who had once struggled to leave their home, will their treatment under knives, needles and lasers help change their skin and lives for good?

programme.title: About Face
programme.desc: Elite surgeons in Los Angeles tackle some of the most complex facial reconstruction cases, helping patients with severe deformities and rare conditions reclaim dignity, hope, and a chance at a new life.

programme.title: Outdaughtered
programme.desc: 40 bottles a day, 420 diapers a week and feedings every three hours became the new normal for Danielle and Adam Busby when they welcomed home the only all-female set of quintuplets in the country. The family of three became a family of eight overnight, and TLC follows that incredible journey in the new series OutDaughtered. The series captures Danielle, Adam and their adorable 4-year-old daughter Blayke as they adjust to their new life, while trying to hold on to the identities and lives they had cultivated before the five new additions arrived. Following the hilarious and heartwarming antics of the entire family including Danielle's zany mother, Michelle, and her older twin sisters and their families, it's all hands on deck as the family relies on their tight-knit circle to make the most out of this incredible lifetime adventure.

programme.title: Doubling Down With the Derricos
programme.desc: Although sleepless nights, sibling squabbles and living rooms full of toe-tripping toys are a regular feature in any home with kids, what really happens when there are 14 of them under one roof? The series features a Las Vegas couple, Karen and Deon, who have had four sets of multiples back to back, with all of them being conceived naturally. The show will showcase the endearing couple who are all set to welcome a set of triplets while raising the elder 11, their ages ranging from 2 to 14. While Karen and Deon both have always wanted to have a big family, a ménage of 14 is not exactly they'd wished for. With both having inherited a gene pool that boasts a lineage of multiple births, the show will portray how the family celebrates and embraces all of life's hurdles and drama with open arms.

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress
programme.desc: Delves into the heart of world famous Kleinfeld Bridal where the staff face immense pressure to help each bride find the dress if her dreams. Take a peak at the brides as they try on their dream dresses! It brings us up close and into the dressing room as brides prepare for their big day. Moms, bridesmaids and friends all express their opinions and often frustrate both bride and staff. In the end though, most brides find that "dream dress" and walk down with their grooms into wedded bliss.

programme.title: Kitchen Boss
programme.desc: Hosted by Buddy Valastro, this cooking program takes various Italian-American dishes from Valastro's own family recipes and shows how they can be prepared in minimal time and using ingredients that are easily obtainable and affordable. Each meal usually consists of a main course, a side dish and a dessert and Buddy is joined in the kitchen by members of his family to show us how it's done and to add authenticity. Episodes feature Buddy and his wife Lisa making chicken Sorrentino with fusilli with a side of asparagus and chocolate dipped strawberries for dessert for date night; Auntie Anna revealing her secret recipes for manicotti and her chicken with vinegar peppers; or Buddy and his cousin Frankie reminiscing about the sights and food of Italian street fairs. The recipe for each dish can be found on the show's website.

programme.title: 90 Day Fiancé: Happily Ever After?
programme.desc: American reality series, a follow-up spinoff of ''90 Day Fiancé'' that features couples who have applied for or received a K-1 visa (available uniquely to foreign fiancés of U.S. citizens) and have ninety days to marry each other, follows some of the most famous and interesting couples from the original show and documents the ups and downs of their relationships after they got married. For some of these couples, the real drama is just starting because they barely know each other and they have to battle critics, doubters, and various obstacles on their road to love. Some of the couples that are featured on the show are Danielle and Mohamed, Melanie and Devar, Loren and Alexei, Kyle and Noon, Brett and Daya and Russ and Paola.

programme.title: Welcome To Plathville
programme.desc: Welcome To Plathville is an American reality series following husband and wife Kim and Barry Plath, and their nine children; Ethan, Hosanna, Micah, Moriah, Lydia, Isaac, Amber, Cassia, and Mercy. Apart from Ethan and Hosanna, who live with their respective spouses, the family reside on a rural farm in Georgia, where the children must abide by Kim and Barry's conservative rules. No sugar, no television, no non-religious music and no video games, the children must follow their parents' strict guidelines, as family life centres around music and God. We follow the family through their daily routines, revealing all the drama that ensues with having so many children.

programme.title: Cake Boss
programme.desc: Carlo's Bakery in Hoboken New Jersey create elaborate, elegant and interesting edible art cakes. Cake Boss follows the team, led by Buddy Valastro, as they design and create two of these masterpieces for all kinds of events and occassions. The show explores the intricacy of working with your family, and their interpersonal relationships with other employees. Watch as they create everything from classic wedding cakes to alien spaceships.

programme.title: 7 Little Johnstons
programme.desc: Amber and Trent Johnston are living the American dream. They have been happily married for 14 years and have five children ranging from 6 to 13 years old. On paper, they might seem like your average family...yet in person, they attract a lot of attention.... because all seven members of the Johnston family – Amber, Trent, their two biological children, Jonah and Elizabeth, as well as their three adopted children, Anna, Emma and Alex – happen to have Achondroplasia Dwarfism. Together, these spunky seven make up the largest known family of Achondroplastic dwarfs in the world, and even describe themselves as "the real life seven dwarfs."

programme.desc: Kody Brown, with his four wives Meri, Janelle, Robyn and Christine and their combined 17 children, attempt to navigate life as a "normal" family in a society that shuns their lifestyle. The series also captures the intense dynamics surrounding a man juggling three wives while attempting to keep it a secret from the outside world- but the general public is not the only challenge that the Brown family unit is facing.

programme.title: Baylen Out Loud
programme.desc: Baylen Out Loud follows the journey of Baylen Dupree, a young woman living with an extreme case of Tourette Syndrome. Despite her daily challenges, Baylen and her family aren't afraid to laugh and embrace the chaos that makes their everyday lives in West Virginia unique. With Baylen yearning for independence, she'll need to rely less on her family as she takes steps toward being in the world on her own.

programme.title: 90 Day Fiancé UK
programme.desc: Taher loses his temper when Nicole reveals concerns over converting to Islam, and Jose puts his music career on hold to provide for his newborn baby.

programme.title: Polyfamily
programme.desc: The quad brings home their fifth child, Quintin! Family members attend a party to meet the new baby, but not everyone is supportive.

programme.title: Body Invaders
programme.desc: From fence posts and refrigerator magnets to surf boards and garden shears, 'I Was Impaled' tells incredible true tales of people from around the world who have accidentally ended up with foreign objects in their bodies. Each story is brought to life by first-person testimony and CGI reconstruction, starting from the discovery of the injury to the groundbreaking medical treatment. It describes in detail how the dangerous, bizarre object entered the body, how it affected organs and influenced behaviour, and why the matter was often inches away from causing death.

programme.title: My Feet Are Killing Me
programme.desc: Quarantining at home hasn't stopped everyone's favorite foot fixers from helping patients with their foot troubles. Dr. Brad and Dr. Ebonie are teaming up with the compassionate and intelligent Dr. Sarah Haller, who is joining the medical series and has been working alongside Dr. Brad for years, on all new episodes of MY FEET ARE KILLING ME: FIRST STEPS. In the midst of a world shutdown by COVID-19, these dynamic foot doctors pledge to help shocking podiatric cases, one video call at a time. Each 30-minute episode will follow three patients as they undergo virtual consultations to begin their journey towards surgeries that will leave their feet radically transformed and their lives changed forever. COVID toes have nothing on these cases!

programme.title: Baylen Out Loud
programme.desc: Baylen Out Loud follows the journey of Baylen Dupree, a young woman living with an extreme case of Tourette Syndrome. Despite her daily challenges, Baylen and her family aren't afraid to laugh and embrace the chaos that makes their everyday lives in West Virginia unique. With Baylen yearning for independence, she'll need to rely less on her family as she takes steps toward being in the world on her own.

programme.title: 90 Day Fiancé UK
programme.desc: Taher loses his temper when Nicole reveals concerns over converting to Islam, and Jose puts his music career on hold to provide for his newborn baby.

programme.title: Border Protection Spain
programme.desc: A routine surveillance check of fishing boats has unpredicted consequences. A suspicious speedboat immediately raises a red flag at headquarters. An interception team is dispatched to investigate. In the Balearic Islands, Coastguard teams are confronted with an unexpected case of alleged domestic violence.

programme.title: Toronto Airport Uncovered
programme.desc: As thunder rumbles and rain pours, maintenance teams carry out urgent post winter repairs, but lightning forces them inside. A hardworking ground support engineer struggles to keep flights on time in the worsening rain. Repairs on a faulty 787 go to the wire. A ramp team has an hour to re-load an entire plane's cargo, and two dogs receive special treatment enroute to their loved ones.

programme.title: Toronto Airport Uncovered
programme.desc: Spring break brings a surge in passenger numbers and added pressures on airport staff and infrastructure: heavy bags rip a section of the baggage conveyor belt which needs fixing before the afternoon rush. A low-cost-holiday jet with millions of miles on the clock needs a new engine. Staff must race passengers from a delayed flight to their jet headed for the Caribbean, and an elite restaurant along with staff on the apron feel the heat as passenger numbers soar.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: When a salmon truck crashes into a ditch, it kicks off a night of havoc for Thord. While Thord and Bjoern attempt to rescue the truck and its load of valuable salmon, Thord must send rookie Domenic on a solo mission to control a chaotic situation, on a notorious accident black-spot. With Thords capacity pushed to the limit, he then dispatches Terje and Ørjan to rescue a bus thats crashed into a ditch. When Terje makes a critical mistake, it only makes matters worse.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: "Ice Road Rescue" portrays a group of heroic tow truck rescue workers. When winter hits Norway the transport roads turn into treacherous bobsleigh tracks. Every day the rescuers fight to keep this routes open by rescuing heavy trailers stuck in the mountain terrain. Winter storms, avalanches and lack of daylight through the winter season are just some of the challenges they have to face, working close to the polar circle. Extreme winter conditions that often make them risk their lives. "Ice Road Rescue" shows the ultimate man versus nature.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Scrapyard Supercar
programme.desc: Petrolhead Shane Lynch is setting two teams of amateur mechanics a task of epic proportions; they have just four days to build monster machines that can out-perform a "top-trump" attribute of a supercar! Under the expert guidance of head-engineer Ralph Hosier, theyve got free reign in an automotive scrapyard to build their vehicles, before going head-to-head on the racetrack to see which performs best. Through the teams trials and tribulations, we will learn how supercars work, and learn just how hard it is to achieve perfection. From acceleration to braking, handling to grip, this is a true test of beauty vs beast. Scrapyard Supercar.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Its a fact of life. From the minute were born, were all getting older. And while its long been believed that both your body and your brain deteriorate over time, recent studies show that may not always be the case. Some brain functions improve as we get older, while other dont fully develop until later in life! In this episode we explore your brain and how it doesnt always act its age. Through a series of games and experiments, you'll discover how your daily routines might be aging your brain . . . and how you can actually slow down the clock. And if you pay attention, youll discover the surprising answer about whether older brains or younger brains come out on top in this Brain Games "Battle of the Ages".

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: What do you see when you look at the world? Does reality really exist the way you experience it? Your brain is constantly taking in different bits of information all at once to make meaningful patterns that eventually form a complete picture of the world around you. Whether it's light, shadow, distance, or sound, the way your brain perceives this information creates your unique perspective. But have you ever stopped to wonder if your brain is actually being fooled-or if your brain is fooling you? In this episode of Brain Games, you'll see how your brain gets tripped up by odd angles, how light and shadows play a crucial role in your perception of the world, how you can radically shift the way you see reality, and how your brain isn't always as honest with you as you think. Through a series of games and experiments, you'll discover why you shouldn't always believe what you see.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: This is a show about your brain and its imagination. We often associate imagination with creativity and the arts, but we don't always think about how important it is to our daily lives. If you play along you'll see how you can use your imagination to solve daily problems, you'll learn how to tap into the imaginative process, and that, with a little help, you can keep the good ideas flowing. Get ready to unleash your imagination…on Brain Games.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation

programme.title: Drain the Oceans
programme.desc: The Age of Dinosaurs - an ancient world of savage, lone T-rexes terrorizing dopey plant-eating diplodocus. So familiar… but so wrong. From the colours of their skin to the way they flock and herd, so much of what we think is true about dinosaurs is either out of date, guesswork, or all-out fantasy. Now a new generation of palaeontologists, armed with the latest tech, are challenging these popular caricatures to uncover the Real Jurassic Americas.

programme.title: Drain the Oceans
programme.desc: Archaeologists explore the coast of Oregon for the remains of a ship that sank over three hundred years ago. Native American oral histories tell of a shipwreck and its survivors. Porcelain and beeswax from the ship still wash up on shore. Archaeologists reconstruct their impression of the sunken wreck, using historical data and their own expertise, revealing how this giant ship carried hundreds of tons of cargo nearly halfway round the world.

programme.title: Gladiators: Warriors of the Ancient World
programme.desc: In the later Roman Empire it was gladiators and emperors alike frequently came from overseas. Emperor Septimius Severus was born in Africa and his wife in Syria, as was a gladiator named Flamma who was captured and sent to fight in Sicily. There, in the ludus, he fights alongside fellow gladiators such as Delicatus, forging bonds that define his career. His epitaph records 34 fights: 21 victories, 9 draws, and only 4 defeats. After his final bout, he dies at the age of 30. His gravestone exposes not only the brutal realities of gladiatorial life but also the comradeship and loyalty of the gladiators. Flamma's story embodies the grandeur, violence, and complexity of Rome's obsession with bloodsport.

programme.title: Gladiators: Warriors of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Emperor Commodus shocks Rome by casting aside tradition and becoming a gladiator. Over 14 days of extravagant games, he slays wild beasts, spars with helpless opponents, and indulges his fantasy of godhood - dressed as Hercules, demanding adoration. Behind the spectacle lies growing discontent: the Senate scorned, the treasury drained, and power abused, as he trains as a gladiator in his country estate. When Commodus plans to inaugurate the new year from the gladiators' barracks, his inner circle panics. Poisoned by his mistress Marcia and strangled by his trainer Narcissus, Commodus dies; a far cry from the hero he imagined. His death sparks civil war, ushering in the Severan dynasty. His legacy is condemned, and Commodus remains one of the most bizarre figures in Roman history, an emperor who tried to rule from the arena, not the throne.

programme.title: Destruction Decoded
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we'll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur.

programme.title: Megastructures
programme.desc: Exciting documentary series that shows viewers some extreme and extraordinary construction projects- the biggest, tallest, longest or deepest in the world, and the machines that are used to create such amazing structures. The series features interviews with designers and project managers, who present the problems of construction and the methodology or techniques used to overcome obstacles. Some ''megastructures'' included in the series are US Navy's aircraft carrier, the USS Ronald Reagan, highway with no speed limit built in Germany, undersea tunnel built between France and United Kingdom, world's longest suspension bridge in Japan, twin tower skyscraper in Kuala Lumpur, etc.

programme.title: Mega Marine Machines
programme.desc: A fire-scarred Great Lakes freighter completes its last journey to a family-run recycling yard on Lake Erie, where turning a dead ship into profit is anything but simple. At MRC's Port Colborne yard, the aging Cuyahoga must be stabilized, stripped and cut apart without contaminating the water or shoreline. Yard manager Jordan Elliott leads a crew working under constant pressure, where time is money and scrap prices can erase profits overnight. The operation hinges on high-risk moments: towing in a powerless ship, navigating brutal financial math, and executing the yard's signature move — using massive rubber airbags to haul the vessel out of the water. It's industrial recycling at full scale, offering a cleaner alternative to global shipbreaking while proving that modern methods can keep steel in circulation without poisoning the future.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: With airplane travel becoming increasingly popular in a shrinking world and millions of passengers journeying this way every day, it is helpful to be aware of the potentail dangers involved. This show presents remarkable stories of some of the most catastrophic accidents in aviation history and investigates the causes of the accidents, what effect they had on the industry and the steps taken to ensure that they don't happen in the future. Each stand-alone episode features compelling re-enactments, expert analysis and interviews with those involved. The explanations for the accidents range from the explosive power of decompression to problems with autopilots and computerised control systems to air traffic control errors.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report

The explanations for the accidents range from the explosive power of decompression to problems with autopilots and computerised control systems to air traffic control errors.

programme.title: Gladiators: Warriors of the Ancient World
programme.desc: In 80 CE, Rome unveils the Colosseum with 100 days of games hosted by Emperor Titus. The spectacles include mock sea battles, gladiator combat, and savage beast hunts. At the centre of the blood-soaked spectacle is Carpophorus, an African beast hunter enslaved by the Romans. Trained in the art of killing wild animals, he becomes a star of the arena, famed for slaying lions, bears, rhinos, and more, drawing comparisons to Hercules. But while crowds cheer, Rome's games exact a toll. Ecosystems across the empire are ravaged; animals are hunted to extinction, and people are enslaved to supply the appetite for bloodsport. When Domitian succeeds Titus, the games grow even more extreme. Today, the Colosseum stands not just as a symbol of Roman might, but as a reminder of the violence, exploitation, and ecological devastation masked as spectacle.

programme.title: Gladiators: Warriors of the Ancient World
programme.desc: A Roman citizen Marcus Attilius chooses to become a gladiator to clear his debts. He wins fame and admiration, becoming a people's hero. His rise occurs as Pompeii's amphitheatre becomes a symbol of Roman dominance and spectacle. But less than two decades later, Vesuvius erupts, destroying the city. Marcus's fate remains a mystery, yet his story lives on through the legacy of Pompeii's games.

programme.title: Construction Fails
programme.desc: Florida experienced one of the deadliest structural failures in American history; India's dams are in distress after an avalanche of disasters; a partial collapse shuts down a Mallorca nightclub; and it's a race against time to save Italy's other leaning tower. We find out what happens when air gets into an airplane and how much huffing and puffing it actually takes to bring a brick house down.

programme.title: Construction Fails
programme.desc: When a faraway earthquake brings a Bangkok skyscraper crashing down, investigators wonder why it was the only one to fail. Was a deadly wind whipped up by the tallest tower in Yorkshire? The destruction of a Danish landmark highlights the risks of historic renovation, a Bronx building collapse shows that any renovation is risky if not done according to plan, and working with mobile cranes reveals a long history of contemporary errors.

programme.title: Disaster Autopsy
programme.desc: Disasters can strike anywhere, anytime. To find out why, expert analysis of the available evidence is used to recreate real world disasters in cutting edge 3D graphics. We can dissect them, peel back the layers, even freeze time to reveal a disaster's hidden and surprising causes – a paperwork error, a bad glue job, changing a restaurant opening hours. Whatever it is, Disaster Autopsy will uncover it.

programme.title: Disaster Autopsy
programme.desc: Disasters can strike anywhere, anytime. To find out why, expert analysis of the available evidence is used to recreate real world disasters in cutting edge 3D graphics. programme.title: Mega Marine Machines
programme.desc: Across southern France, two radically different wind machines pursue the same modern obsession: more speed, more control and almost no margin for error. In Saint-Tropez, SailGP's F50 catamarans — often called Formula One on water — race inches apart on tight courses, where split-second decisions and flawless systems keep disaster at bay. In Leucate, the SP80 team takes a different path, training a kite-powered trimaran built for one purpose only: straight-line speed, with an audacious goal of 150 kilometers per hour. Though their designs diverge, both collide with the same invisible enemy — cavitation. The moment water vaporizes, lift collapses and control vanishes. As sailors, engineers and designers push beyond known limits, wind-driven sport becomes applied engineering, dragging marine technology into an uncertain and faster future.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Even during a pandemic, smuggling never stops. After adjusting tactics in the early days of the COVID crisis to meet the increasing flow of narcotics coming across our southern land borders, the Department of Homeland Security is now pivoting back to our nation's airports where international travel is starting to rev back up again. Whether narco-traffickers try to slip through an airport, seaport or land crossing, vigilant officers are on high-alert to stem the flow of illegal contraband. Using every tool available to them, DHS will stop at nothing to catch a smuggler.

programme.title: Border Protection Spain
programme.desc: A quiet day turns tense as drug traffickers lead the Coastguard's boats and helicopters on a high-speed chase as they try to reach Moroccan waters, where the Spanish teams have no jurisdiction. An illegal fishing boat has entered a protected nature reserve and must be stopped. And a distress call comes in for a dinghy drifting in dangerous waters with 14 people onboard.

programme.desc: Suvine uudistemagasin liigub sinna, kus Eesti suvi parajasti kõige elavamalt keeb. Saade toob vaatajani päeva olulisemad sündmused, värvikad inimesed ja meeleolukad lood rannast, linnamelust, festivalidelt, külapidudelt, aga ka Meediamaja rõdult. Reporterile omases hoogsas võtmes jõuavad ekraanile värsked uudised, elulised reportaažid, ootamatud kohtumised ja hetked, mis teevad Eesti suve eriliseks. Saatejuhid Jaanus Koort, Simon Suviste ja Tõnis Sarap hoiavad silma peal nii tõsisematel teemadel kui ka suvistel seikadel meil ja mujal maailmas.

programme.title: Kolm reklaamtahvlit linna servas
programme.desc: USA/ Suurbritannia 2017 draama, komöödia,krimi Lavastaja:Martin McDonagh Osades:Frances McDormand, Woody Harrelson, Sam Rockwell, Peter Dinklage, Abbie Cornish, Caleb Landry Jones, John Hawkes Mildred Hayes (Oscari-võitja Frances McDormand) on eluraskuste poolt kõvaks keedetud lahutatud naine, keda piinab päevast päeva Missouri väikelinna Ebbingi politsei tegevusetus. Mildredi teismelise tütre mõrva uurimine pole kuhugi välja viinud ning mitme kuu jooksul pole kinni peetud ainsatki kahtlusalust. Naine paneb kohaliku konnatiigi lainetama, rentides linna toova maantee ääres kolm reklaamtahvlit, mille sisu on otseseks väljakutseks kohalikule korrakaitsele, täpsemalt šerif William Willoughbyle (Woody Harrelson). Kui sündmuste käiku sekkub šerifi parem käsi, ebaküps vägivaldne memmekas Dixon (Sam Rockwell), aitab see konflikti lahendamisele kaasa sama edukalt kui bensiiniga täidetud tulekustuti.

programme.title: Liikleja
programme.desc: Mis on Eesti liikluses valesti? Mille üle saab uhke olla? Milliste reeglite vastu kõige enam eksitakse? Saatesari "Liikleja" võtab kord kuus luubi alla ühe liiklusohutusalase teema. "Liikleja" näitab, mis toimub Eesti liikluses, annab nõu ja jagab näpunäiteid, mis on elupäästvad ning muudavad liikluse Eestis ohutumaks. Mis vahe on väsimusel ja unisusel? Mida ette võtta, kui meid tabab roolis uni? Mis haigus on uneapnoe? Sel korral uuritakse \"Liikleja\" saates, kuidas mõjutavad sõidukijuhti vähene ja ebakvaliteetne uni ning välised faktorid nagu stress? Saates saavad sõna Transpordiameti liiklusekspert, unearst, psühholoog ja Sotsiaalministeeriumi ravimiosakonna nõunik. Saatejuht on Jaanus Koort.

programme.title: Hommikuks surnud
programme.desc: Kolledžisõbrad lähevad Lõuna-California idüllilisse linna peole. Kuid kui voolab alkohol ja vohab armukadedus, võib õhtu lõppeda surmaga. Juhtum jääb rohkem kui kümnendiks lahendamata, enne kui tõde lõpuks ilmsiks tuleb ja õiglus võidule pääseb.

programme.title: New Yorgi mõrvad
programme.desc: Mõned päevad enne uue aastatuhande algust annab vangistuses olev informaator NYPD-le salapärase vihje mõrvast. Uurijad hakkavad läbi käima New Yorgi pilvelõhkujaid, et leida mõrvapaik ja surnukeha.

programme.title: Suvereporter
programme.desc: Suvine uudistemagasin liigub sinna, kus Eesti suvi parajasti kõige elavamalt keeb. Saade toob vaatajani päeva olulisemad sündmused, värvikad inimesed ja meeleolukad lood rannast, linnamelust, festivalidelt, külapidudelt, aga ka Meediamaja rõdult. Reporterile omases hoogsas võtmes jõuavad ekraanile värsked uudised, elulised reportaažid, ootamatud kohtumised ja hetked, mis teevad Eesti suve eriliseks. Saatejuhid Jaanus Koort, Simon Suviste ja Tõnis Sarap hoiavad silma peal nii tõsisematel teemadel kui ka suvistel seikadel meil ja mujal maailmas.

Basketball: FIBA Basketball World Cup Qualifiers. Estonia - Slovenia
Wimbledon. Highlights Day 9
programme.desc: Wimbledon is more than just a tennis tournament — it's a summer tradition, a slice of British culture, and one of the most iconic sporting events in the world. Held every year in London, England, usually in late June to early July, it's where the best tennis players on the planet come to battle it out on the famous grass courts of the All England Club. It's actually the oldest tennis tournament in the world, dating back to 1877, and it's still the only Grand Slam played on grass — the fastest and most unpredictable surface. That's part of what makes it so exciting. Matches are intense, fast-paced, and full of surprises. Wimbledon is packed with unique traditions that make it stand out. Players are required to wear all white on court — no exceptions. The crowd enjoys strawberries and cream, and you won't see flashy ads around the court — it's all about the game. And of course, there's the Royal Box, where you might spot celebrities or even members of the British Royal Family watching the action. From rising stars to tennis legends, everyone dreams of lifting the famous Wimbledon trophy. There's something magical about seeing players walk onto Centre Court, hearing the roar of the crowd, and witnessing moments that go down in sports history. Whether you're a tennis fan or just love great sports drama, Wimbledon is a must-watch — classy, thrilling, and full of unforgettable moments.

Kartmatud saatejuhid Indrek Vaheoja ja Kristjan Rabi proovivad erinevaid ameteid, võtavad vastu külalisi ja jagavad ellujäämise saladusi neljal õhtul nädalas. Lisaks saab Eestimaa kirjust suvest osa vaatajate koduvideote kaudu.

programme.title: Kodu keset linna
programme.desc: Seriaali keskmes on Tallinnas elav perekond - noor naine, tema keskealine mees ja nende väike poeg. Sarja intriigide käivitajaks on mehe eelmine perekond. Põnevust lisavad ka naabrid, sugulased ja tuttavad. Tegevus toimub tänapäeva Eestis ning sarjas, nii nagu ka päris elus, on armastust ja vihkamist, pettumust, leppimist, armukadedust ning huumorit. Sarja peaosatäitjateks on näitlejad Eesti erinevatest teatritest. Martin Veinmann kehastab sarjas pereisa Hannest, tema noort naist Helenit mängib Kleer Maibaum, perepea esimest naist Epp Eespäev ning pereisa tütart esimesest abielust kehastab Kadri Adamson

programme.title: TV3 uudised
programme.desc: TV3 uudistetoimetus võtab igal õhtul operatiivselt ja asjatundlikult kokku olulisemad päevasündmused nii Eestist kui ka mujalt maailmast. Kui igatsed uudistesaadet, mis on aktuaalne, täpne, pisut terav, südamlik ning kus saab ka grammikese nalja, siis õige valik on "TV3 uudised". "TV3 uudised" on eetris igal õhtul kell 19.00. Argipäeviti mahub tunniajasesse saatesse põhjalik ülevaade nii Eestist kui välismaalt. Räägime näiliselt keerulistest asjadest selgelt ja arusaadavalt - sest aega on. Uudistesaate juhid on Liina Kanarbik, Marek Lindmaa ja Tarmo Maiberg. Reportaaže otse sündmuskohtadelt toovad teieni Sirje Eesmaa, Allan Muuk, Sven Soiver, Virgo Pärn, Kadri Pikhof, Marie Metsur, Christina Veinberg ja Tiina Laura Kimmel.

programme.title: Kaitseingel on langenud
programme.desc: USA 2019 põnevusmärul. Mike Banning annab riigiteenistuses endast kõik. Tema peamine ülesanne on USA presidendi julgeoleku tagamine. Banning, pikka aega presidenti kaitsnud ning julgeolekusüsteemiga läbi ja lõhki tuttav, ajab suurte terrorirühmituste kavatsused korduvalt luhta. Seekord on terroristid aga sepitsenud märksa nutikama plaani: targast salateenistuse agendist iga hinna eest vabaneda.Saanud terroristide kõige ohtlikumaks sihtmärgiks, kirjutab Banning alla oma surmaotsusele: teda süüdistatakse USA presidendi elu kallale kippumises. Vanad relvavennad ei usalda teda, sest kahtlustavad, et ta kavatseb presidendi tappa. Et päästa oma hea nimi ja eelkõige elu, peab Banning välja uurima, kes ja miks mängib tema ja presidendiga saatanlikku mängu. Agent oletab, et seekord on terroristidel plaan õhkida riigipea lennuk. Lavastaja:Ric Roman Waugh Osades:Gerard Butler, Lance Reddick, Morgan Freeman, Piper Perabo, Jada Pinkett-Smith, Nick Nolte, Tim Blake Nelson, Danny Huston

programme.title: Suure paugu teooria
programme.desc: Sheldon ja Amy on endiselt teooria kummutamise pärast löödud, aga videokassett Sheldoni minevikust inspireerib meest mitte alla andma. Bernadette muutub üliagaraks lavaemmeks, kui aitab Wolowitzil tähtsaks prooviesinemiseks valmistuda.

programme.title: Kutsuge Cobra 11
programme.desc: Vennad Ronnie ja Malte pressivad kurjategija Bogdanilt raha välja. Viimane varastas haruldase lõhkeaine. Politseil tuleb tabada kurjategija enne kui ta jõuab lõhkeainet kasutada, lisaks tuleb ka Ronnie ja Malte elu päästa.

programme.title: Walker, Texase korravalvur
programme.desc: Bobbie Hunt asub salaja tegutsema 10-aastase Nicky Matacio juhendaja. Bobbie loodab tabada poisi isa ja viia Nicky ema juurde tagasi.

programme.title: Kutsuge Cobra 11
programme.desc: Sõjalennuk teeb tehnilise rikke tõttu hädamaandumise. Esialgu jääb süüdlaseks noor piloot, sest arvatakse, et tal pole piisavalt kogemusi. Semir ja Ben avastavad, et lennuväebaasis tegeleb keegi ebaseadusliku varuosadeäriga. Kasumliku äri jätkamiseks on ta valmis üle laipade minema.

programme.title: Simpsonid
programme.desc: Käes on jälle halloween ning Simpsonitega toimub igasuguseid õudusi. Sideshow Bobil õnnestub lõpuks Bart tappa, kuid äratab ta siis poisi uuesti ellu. Homerzilla terroriseerib Springfieldi. Lisa ja Milhouse saavad kiirituse tõttu supervõimed.

programme.title: Perepea
programme.desc: "Perepea" on Ameerika Ühendriikide animeeritud situatsioonikomöödia, mille autor on Seth MacFarlane. Sari räägib perekond Griffinitest, kes elavad väljamõeldud Quahogi-nimelises linnas, mis asub Rhode Islandil.

programme.title: Suure paugu teooria
programme.desc: Penny ja Leonard organiseerivad värvisõja, mille tulemuseks on suur segadus, kui Sheldon on Amy peale armukade. Koothrappali näeb, kui Anu on koos oma endise kallimaga. Stuart ei taha Denise'iga kokku kolida.

programme.title: Suure paugu teooria
programme.desc: Ambitsioonikas filminäitlejanna Penny kolib Pasadena korterisse, mis asub säravate ja sotsiaalselt kohmakate füüsikute Sheldon Cooperi ja Leonard Hofstadteri vastas ning näitab neile, kui vähe nad teavad elust väljaspool laborit.

programme.title: Kiired ja vihased
programme.desc: USA-Saksamaa 2001 märul Lavastaja: Rob Cohen Osades: Vin Diesel, Paul Walker, Jordana Brewster, Michelle Rodriguez Dominic Toretto (Vin Diesel) sõidab L.A. tänavatel nagu kuuluks need talle. Päevad veedab ta oma töökojas, remontides teiste autosid, öösiti on ta aga tänavate kuningas, kes teenib kuni 10 000 dollarit võidusõidu pealt. Seda muidugi juhul, kui leidub keegi, kes julgeb talle väljakutse esitada. Brian (Paul Walker) on just selline, pealtnäha hulljulge seikleja, kes tahaks pääseda Dominici ohtlikku maailma, mida ajavad edasi adrenaliin, seksuaalne pinge ja toores, kontrollimatu kiirus. Seejuures peab Brian olema äärmiselt ettevaatlik, et ettearvamatu Dominic ega seksikas Mia (Jordana Brewster) ei saaks teada tema sealviibimise tegelikku põhjust…

programme.title: Kurvid sirgeks YR1 2026 EP 4
programme.desc: Rallisaate "Kurvid sirgeks" neljas episood toob vaatajateni Kreeka WRC ralli ülevaate, fookuses eesti autosportlased. Kes olid need armunud noored, kes kandideerisid sellesse saatesse? Millega tehti end nähtavaks? Kas jäädi sündsuse piiridesse? Sarja trumbiks on haaravad ja inimlikult usutavad tegelaskujud, kelle eludega on vaatajal kerge samastuda. Tegelaste galerii on ka piisavalt mitmekesine, et igaüks leiaks endale lemmiku, kellele kaasa elada - siin on nii teismelisi, noori täiskasvanuid kui ka juba küpsesse keskikka jõudnud peategelasi. Jovana otsustab mägedesse ratsutama minna ja saatjaks satub olema Finn, kellega tal kunagi suhe oli. Mees on Jovanasse endiselt armunud.
